title: Setup mode: start on an empty database; home club as a stored setting
description: Today config.Load requires a clubs row and main.go calls log.Fatalf before the server listens, so an empty database can never be set up through the UI (audit 6.3, the 'bootstrap deadlock'). Introduce an app_settings table and a 'needs setup' state. When no home club is configured and no administrator exists, the server starts normally but routes every request except static assets, /healthz and /setup to the setup flow (WI-117). The home club is resolved in this order: HOME_CLUB_ID env, HOME_CLUB_NAME env, stored setting. Because the home club can now change at runtime (when setup completes), the config middleware must read it from a holder that can be updated rather than a value frozen at startup. Also fix the latent crash where a clubs row with NULL address/website/phone_number fails to scan into models.Club and produces a misleading 'does not match any club' error.

recommended_model.name: Opus 5.5
recommended_model.rationale: Touches startup, config injection and every handler's view of the home club; needs careful reasoning about state that used to be immutable.

acceptance_criteria: With an empty database and no HOME_CLUB_* variables the server starts, listens, and serves the setup entry page
A migration adds app_settings (key/value, updated_at); a settings repository provides typed getters and setters
Home club resolution order is env ID, env name, stored setting; with env set, behaviour is identical to today
Completing setup makes the home club effective without restarting the process
A clubs row with NULL optional columns loads without error
The compose health check passes on a brand-new volume
The e2e bootstrap no longer depends on a pre-seeded club for the health check (tests/e2e fixtures and audit 6.3 updated)

files_to_create: migrations/030_app_settings.up.sql / .down.sql (tentative number - take the next free one; never reuse 026)
notes: admin.New and players.New currently receive the config value at construction (main.go:102,105) - they need the live holder.
Keep the helpful 'available clubs' error for the case where an env value is set but matches nothing.

testing_requirements: Unit tests for resolution order and the NULL-column scan
Start against an empty volume in Docker and confirm health goes green

context.user_story: As a new club's volunteer, I want the app to open a setup page on first start so that I never need to touch the database.
context.programme: Club-readiness programme (sprints 019-024). Agreed constraints: BHPLTA clubs only; each club self-hosts its own instance; the original author must have no access to any other club's instance (no seeded accounts, no shared or default secrets, no phone-home); passkeys are the default sign-in with passwords as an optional fallback; the captain role is real; SQLite is the only supported database; CourtHive is bundled as an opt-in part of the package so clubs can run their own club championships.
